cases.note: No posting anywhere in the workspace; the 'tighten it up' wording from earlier in the eval's conversation is folded into turn 1.
turns: Before we go any further, can we look at my resume (resume.md) and optimize it? Just tighten it up.
Optimize my resume (resume.md). I have a website at example.com/about, use it to fill in details about my company.
Tailor my resume for this Senior Backend Engineer role at Stripe. My resume is resume.md and the posting is in stripe_posting.txt.

cases.note: The posting URL is fictional and will not resolve; the scenario covers routing and the gap-analysis ask, not the fetch.
turns: Tailor my resume for this role: https://jobs.example.com/senior-pm-stripe. My resume is resume.md.

cases.note: A cover-letter ask filed under resume-tailor's evals; cover-letter loading is the family-correct route, so read a miss here as routed elsewhere, not as an under-trigger.
turns: I want a cover letter for this Greenhouse role (greenhouse_posting.txt). My resume (resume.md) is heavy on backend but the role wants ML experience, which I don't really have.

cases.note: draft.md is the overstated first draft the eval describes ('Senior Data Analyst', 'Led the checkout redesign team').
